answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university.
The president leads the university leadership which sets the budget.
Members do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions outside their specific place.
The president leads the university and does not belong to a specific faculty council.
The president's place of decision is central leadership, not faculty study commissions.
The president does not take part in faculty examination boards.
The president handles central matters rather than faculty internal research funding.
The president does not participate in working groups for specific degree programmes.
The president does not take part in laboratory equipment procurement.
The president does not participate in orientation week planning.
